stem: An airplane can travel at a speed of 100 m/s in still air. There is steady wind of 60 m/s towards East. The airplane travels along the sides of a square of side 16 km which are along N-S and E-W direction. Find the time taken to complete one round of the square?

assets.alt: A square route of side 16 km flown with a 60 m/s wind from the west: east 100 + 60 = 160 m/s, north √(100² − 60²) = 80 m/s, west 100 − 60 = 40 m/s, south 80 m/s.
